enrichment.headline: Awards Deco Tech Systems $101,854 to install about 20 new security cameras at Lincoln Elementary
enrichment.summary: The board is choosing Deco Tech Systems as the lowest responsive, responsible bidder and rejecting all other bids. The company will install about 20 new cameras, fix one existing camera, supply about 3 spare cameras and replace the recording server at Lincoln Elementary School. The amount includes a $9,000 contingency allowance, and work is expected to run from August 27 to November 25, 2026.
